sn9.1:3.1: This verse is particularly tricky; see Bodhi’s note in *Connected Discourses* for discussion and other interpretations. | _Pajahāsi_ and _bhavāsi_ are reflexive second person singular imperative (= _pajaha_, _bhava_).
sn9.1:3.2: _Sārayāmase_ is reflexive first person plural imperative causative (= _sārayāma_). The deity is using the “royal we”. | I take _taṁ_ as accusative (“you”) and _sataṁ_ as accusative of purpose (“for the purpose of being mindful”).
